movement.description: True for requests to travel, enter, leave, return, explore, or follow someone, even if the destination is unresolved. False for observations, negated or hypothetical movement.

text.description: First extract the complete destination phrase. If a place is specified along with a direction, use the place: 'Head north towards the Great Forest' targets 'the Great Forest', not 'north'. Preserve unresolved references.

kind.description: A specified place takes priority: 'north towards the Great Forest' is named, NOT directional. named also includes place types (wilderness, tavern). reference: there/him; relative: outside; back: retracing; directional: direction or route WITHOUT a specified place; exploratory: open-ended exploration.

target.description: Null only when movement is false.
